resources.string: Drafts chat replies in your Claude app

When you tap the bubble, the Reply with Claude tile or the accessibility button, Reply Drafter reads the chat on screen (scrolling back a little to get earlier messages), and opens your Claude app with it so Claude can draft a reply in your style. It can then paste Claude\'s reply into the message box. It never sends a message, and it reads nothing until you tap it. Only your own messages are kept on this phone, to learn how you write.
